_how: Feeds for brands without product catalogs (services). Each feed lists Impact campaign (program) IDs; the script pulls that brand's current ads (banners and text links) with your tracking links. You can also add offers by hand under 'items' with a title, url (an Impact tracking link) and optional image/description. Use '_titles' to replace an ad's built-in name with your own headline (matched on part of the ad name), and '_hide' to leave ads out (matched on part of the ad name). Ads that end up with the same headline are shown once. The run log lists every ad name under 'Offers:'.
